title: Holding Company Equity Stake For Sale in Geneva, Switzerland
tagline: Swiss-sponsored permanent-capital holding (no fixed liquidation date) that acquires and builds profitable service businesses for the long term (20-30 year horizon). - Two anchor programmes run in parallel: (A) an integrated Swiss healthcare network expanding to the Gulf and Europe, and (B) a majority investment in a leading independent European accounting & advisory network. - Two enabling programmes: a proprietary technology layer (ERP, billing and capital-management tools) and a healthcare real-estate company holding the clinic premises. - One SPV per programme: investors can back the whole platform or a single programme. - Built IPO-ready from day one (IFRS, Big 4 audit, listed-company governance). IPO remains an option, never an obligation. - First closing targeted H1 2027; closings are modular (one programme or several).
